question: How does the occasion granted by the siddha lord affect the kula lord?
premises: An occasion is provided by the siddha lord.
The kula lord is the recipient of this occasion.
The kula lord becomes satisfied as a result.
inference: Through the occasion granted by the siddha lord, the kula lord is satisfied.
plain_english: By the opportunity given by the siddha lord, the lord of the kula was satisfied.
